about_the_game:
This is a traditional Japanese RPG game, narrating the story of the protagonist "William" who has lost his memory. The game revolves around themes of soul, memory, curse, and redemption. Players embark on an adventure with their companions to gradually uncover the mysteries of the lost kingdom and the mysterious crystal ...

The game contains a substantial amount of text-based storylines and cutscene CGs. The normal playtime is around 6-7 hours

The gameplay is a semi-open world exploration with a turn-based combat system. Players can explore the map of the current chapter, with some areas requiring light puzzle-solving and a few side quests. Upon completion, players can obtain rewards such as items that enhance character abilities or blueprints for crafting items. (If you get lost and don't know how to proceed, you can open your inventory to check the hints in important items, which will guide you on what to do next.) Note: The game itself is a linear game, and once the storyline of each chapter is completed, players cannot return to the map of that chapter.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains a small amount of provocative language, some cartoon violence, and specific scenes featuring characters drinking alcohol.
But there will be no sexual behavior between characters or related plot descriptions.

short_description: 这是一款剧情向魔幻悬疑风格的半开放世界rpg游戏。 故事围绕着失去记忆的主人公“威廉”坠入“食人大洞”而展开，游戏以灵魂，记忆，悔过以及救赎为主题，玩家将参与其中与同伴来逐渐揭开失落国度以及神秘结晶的神秘面纱....
